coaching.lockedWelcomeText: Hi, I'm your AI Career Coach. Based on your exploration results, I'll help you gain deeper insight into your career direction.
coaching.lockedCardTitle: Complete your Quick Dive to start the conversation
coaching.pageSubtitle: A 4-week coaching program with weekly sessions to sharpen your career clarity and refine your personal profile.
coaching.week1Desc: Review your report findings, prioritize 2–3 directions worth exploring, and set concrete exploration goals.
coaching.week2Desc: Conduct informational interviews, test your assumptions against reality, and document findings.
coaching.week3Desc: Narrow your focus, identify skill gaps, and build a realistic transition plan with milestones.
coaching.week4Desc: Execute your plan, update your profile with new insights, and set 30/60/90-day milestones.
coaching.featureProfile: Profile accuracy improves with each session
coaching.featureFlexible: Flexible pace — adjust to your schedule
coaching.startTrialDesc: No payment required during trial period.
coaching.faq1A: You'll be prompted to unlock the full 30-day plan. During the trial, you have full access to Week 1 content and one AI coaching session.
coaching.faq2A: Yes. Your trial has no commitment. If you don't continue, your existing profile and reports remain accessible.
coaching.faq3Q: How is my data used during coaching?
coaching.faq3A: Coaching sessions use your assessment results and report to provide personalized guidance. Your conversations are private and stored securely.
coaching.trialStartSubtitle: Tell us a bit about your goals so your AI coach can personalize your plan.
coaching.goalLabel: What's your primary goal for the next 30 days?
coaching.goalClarity: Gain clarity on what I want
coaching.trialActivatedDesc: Your 7-day trial has started. Check your dashboard for your first coaching session.
coaching.profileCtaDesc: Start your AI coaching trial to improve profile accuracy and get a personalized action plan.

coaching.lobbyGreetingGeneric: Hey, glad to see you here.
coaching.lobbyJourneyAck: You've come a long way in your exploration journey.
coaching.lobbyIntro: Your AI coach has studied your report and profile. Through conversation, it will help you turn insights into action.
coaching.lobbyCanDoTitle: What your coach can help with
coaching.lobbyCanDo1: Unpack key patterns from your report
coaching.lobbyCanDo2: Explore career directions that fit you
coaching.lobbyCanDo3: Create a concrete, personalized next step
coaching.lobbyPrepDesc: Find a quiet moment and give yourself 10–15 minutes. Coaching works best when you're calm and present. There are no right or wrong answers — only what's true for you.
coaching.observatorySubtitle: A private coaching space that reads your profile context, turns reflection into a clean decision, and keeps the next step small enough to test.
coaching.observatorySessionTitle: Start with the real decision in front of you.
coaching.observatorySessionPrompt: Bring one choice, tension, or pattern. The coach will help you name the trade-off, pressure-test the assumptions, and leave with one grounded experiment.
coaching.observatoryModeTitle: Choose the kind of thinking you need
coaching.observatoryActionSubtitle: Each session resolves into a compact next step instead of a motivational speech.
coaching.observatoryActionStep1Desc: Get the real question into one sentence.
coaching.observatoryActionStep3Desc: Leave with a small move you can actually run.
coaching.observatoryActionBoundary: Saved only as coaching context you can review.
